mapper.select: SELECT * FROM finance_receipt WHERE id = #{receiptId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN amount WHEN entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM finance_write_off WHERE source_type = 'RECEIPT' AND source_id = #{receiptId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_receipt (receipt_no, customer_id, customer_name_snapshot, amount, method, received_at, entry_type, reverse_of_id, reason, external_reference, remark, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{receiptNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerNameSnapshot}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{receivedAt}, #{entryType}, #{reverseOfId}, #{reason}, #{externalReference}, #{remark}, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (reverse_of_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND entry_type = 'REVERSE' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_receipt WHERE reverse_of_id = #{receiptId} AND entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS receiptId, r.receipt_no AS receiptNo, r.customer_id AS customerId, r.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, r.amount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN r.amount - reversed.reversedAmount ELSE 0 END AS effectiveAmount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN used.usedAmount ELSE 0 END AS usedAmount, CASE WHEN r.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN GREATEST(r.amount - reversed.reversedAmount - used.usedAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pendingWriteOffAmount, r.method, r.entry_type AS entryType, r.reverse_of_id AS reverseOfId, original.receipt_no AS reverseOfNo, r.reason, r.received_at AS receivedAt, r.external_reference AS externalReference, r.remark FROM finance_receipt r LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN finance_receipt original ON original.id = r.reverse_of_id AND original.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reverse.amount), 0) AS reversedAmount FROM finance_receipt reverse WHERE reverse.reverse_of_id = r.id AND reverse.entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND reverse.deleted = FALSE ) reversed ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wo.entry_type = 'NORMAL' THEN wo.amount WHEN wo.entry_type = 'REVERSE' THEN -wo.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS usedAmount FROM finance_write_off wo WHERE wo.source_type = 'RECEIPT' AND wo.source_id = r.id AND wo.deleted = FALSE ) used ON TRUE
mapper.select: WHERE r.reverse_of_id = #{receiptId} AND r.entry_type = 'REVERSE' AND r.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
